contract: Socket.IO outgoing share_open: preserve the payload field types/optional arguments, recipient decisions, trigger conditions and observable ordering at ALL listed source call sites. Source audience hints: admin_clients. Verify authorized/admin/owner/restricted/revoked sockets and initial/repeat/changed/failure transitions; literal test mentions below are discovery leads only.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.

invariants.contract: Opening a media item share (POST /api/share/mediaitem) emits exactly one share_open per created share, after the row is persisted, to every authenticated admin socket through SocketAuthority.adminEmitter. The event has one argument: the same client JSON the create route returned (id, mediaItemId, mediaItemType, slug, expiresAt, createdAt, updatedAt, isDownloadable). Non-admin and unauthenticated sockets never receive it, rejected creates emit nothing, and a deleted-then-recreated share emits one new event carrying the new share id.
exceptions: Audience is admin sockets only (SocketAuthority.adminEmitter), not all authorized clients.
force is not applicable: no share management or public consumer route has a force, hard or refresh/override mode.
